analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains at 40.5 in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram has worsened to -555.2894, showing weak trend reversal signals. The volume ratio to the 5-day average is 1.01, indicating normal levels. The current price of 170,700 KRW is close to the lower Bollinger Band of 170,195 KRW.
